parts.instructions: Hér eru fimm myndir. Segðu hvað er að gerast á hverri mynd. Segja þarf minnst 1 setningu um hverja mynd. Mundu að nota setningar en ekki stök orð.
parts.instructionsTranslation: Here are five pictures. Say what is happening in each picture. You must say at least 1 sentence about each picture. Remember to use sentences, not single words.

pictures.imageDescription: A woman buying fruit at a small grocery store. She is holding apples and talking to the cashier.
pictures.expectedResponse: Konan er að kaupa ávexti í verslun. Hún er með epli í hendinni.

pictures.imageDescription: A man jogging in a park on a sunny day. He is wearing shorts and a t-shirt. There are trees and a path.
pictures.expectedResponse: Maður er að hlaupa í garðinum. Veðrið er gott og sólin skín.

pictures.imageDescription: Two children sitting at a table doing homework. Books and pencils are on the table. A lamp is on.
pictures.expectedResponse: Tvö börn eru að gera heimanám við borðið. Það eru bækur og blýantar á borðinu.

pictures.imageDescription: A bus stop scene: a few people waiting, a bus approaching. It is raining and people have umbrellas.
pictures.expectedResponse: Fólk bíður eftir strætó og það er að rigna. Sumir eru með regnhlífar.

pictures.imageDescription: A family eating dinner together at a table. Parents and two children. The table has fish, potatoes, and salad.
pictures.expectedResponse: Fjölskyldan borðar kvöldmat saman. Á borðinu er fiskur, kartöflur og salat.

taskCompletion.description: Did the test-taker describe all 5 pictures? At least 1 sentence per picture? Did they use full sentences (not just single words)?

vocabulary.description: A2-appropriate vocabulary for describing everyday scenes. Correct naming of objects, people, actions.

grammar.description: Basic sentence construction. Subject-verb agreement. Correct use of 'vera að + infinitive' for ongoing actions.

fluency.description: Speaks in connected sentences rather than isolated words. Reasonable pace (can pause but maintains flow).

comprehensibility.description: Can a native Icelandic speaker understand the intended meaning? Clear enough pronunciation to be transcribed correctly.

parts.instructions: Talaðu um efnið hér að neðan. Segðu minnst 5 setningar. Mundu að tala eðlilega og skiljanlega íslensku og nota setningar en ekki stök orð.
parts.instructionsTranslation: Speak about the topic below. Say at least 5 sentences. Remember to speak natural and understandable Icelandic and use sentences, not single words.
parts.topic: Fjölskyldan mín. Segðu frá fjölskyldunni þinni.
parts.topicTranslation: My family. Tell about your family.
parts.sampleAnswer: Ég á stóra fjölskyldu. Ég er giftur og á tvö börn. Sonur minn er átta ára og dóttir mín er fimm ára. Konan mín vinnur á skrifstofu. Við búum í Reykjavík og fjölskyldan mín í heimalandinu saknar okkar mikið. Foreldrar mínir búa enn í heimalandinu mínu.

taskCompletion.description: Did the test-taker speak about their family? At least 5 sentences? Covered relevant aspects (members, ages, where they live, what they do)?

vocabulary.description: Family vocabulary (fjölskylda, börn, foreldrar, systkini, maki). Numbers and ages. Places. Occupations.

grammar.description: Possessives (minn, mín, mitt). Verb conjugation in present tense. Basic sentence structure. Numbers with correct case.

fluency.description: Connected speech. Speaks at a reasonable pace. Uses some connectors (og, en, líka).

comprehensibility.description: Can a native Icelandic speaker understand the content? Clear enough to be transcribed accurately?
